text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A massive crowd has gathered here at 
Chukyo Racecourse. The Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen will get underway shortly.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the hype is real! If Oguri were 
running in this too, it probably would've 
been even crazier.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, if she could run sprints too, the 
strongest would truly be unstoppable! 
Like, 'Why not just have Oguri run 
everything?!'"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—So it begins, huh. My path to becoming 
the strongest in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm just purely excited!! I'm totally 
fired up!! I can't wait to get out there 
and run!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm headin' out, boss!!
